title: hesperus boundary policy
description: What each part of the repo may reach outside itself. Read by the Hesperus extension and `hesperus check`; mirrored by vscode/src/core/lint.ts.

boundaries.description: Packages to file under a boundary, beyond the built-in table: exact package or module names, or /regex/.

rules.description: Checked in order; the first rule that denies a crossing reports it.

paths.description: Globs on repo-relative paths (**, *, ?). A bare folder means everything in it. Default: everything.

deny.description: Boundaries code here may not reach.

allow.description: The only boundaries code here may reach.

review.description: How loudly to report changes since the last accepted baseline.
